title: USF-211 pgBackRest Configured Local Cold Backup Restore Proof Boundary

remainingProofBoundary.riskStatement: Bounded local cold backup and restore drill proof could be overclaimed as backup readiness, restore readiness, PITR, RPO/RTO, disaster recovery readiness, environment promotion readiness, live/provider-managed pgBackRest compatibility, API runtime backup binding, or worker runtime backup binding.
remainingProofBoundary.treatment: USF-211 resolves only maintained digest-pinned local pgBackRest image authority, configured repository, stanza, synthetic Postgres cold full backup, restore readback, cleanup, readiness retry, timeout, and unavailable fail-closed proof. Separate source issues and proof are required before broader backup/restore, DR, live-provider, environment, API, or worker runtime claims.
requiredEvidence: online backup and WAL archive evidence before any online backup or PITR claim
scheduled backup operations and retention execution before any backup operations readiness claim
RPO/RTO and disaster recovery drill proof before any DR readiness claim
environment-specific backup promotion gates before any dev/test/staging/production readiness claim
live/provider-managed pgBackRest supplier and credential evidence before any live-provider claim
API runtime backup-port integration proof before any API pgBackRest runtime-use claim
worker runtime backup-port integration proof before any worker pgBackRest runtime-use claim

cliProviderBoundary.boundary: pgBackRest is primarily operated through the official pgbackrest CLI. No maintained TypeScript SDK is selected. CLI use is confined to packages/proof/src/pgbackrest-configured-proof.ts and is not imported into core, ports, capabilities, API routes, worker orchestration, or PDP code.
cliProviderBoundary.selectionRationale: pgBackRest v2.58.0 is the current stable upstream release line for the proof boundary, and the woblerr/pgbackrest image exposes that official CLI in a pullable digest-pinned local Compose image. Raw network protocol calls, socket protocol clients, ad hoc database dump commands, and shelling to Postgres backup substitutes were rejected because the official pgbackrest CLI is the maintained product interface for this service.
cliProviderBoundary.licencePosture: No npm SDK dependency is added. Container image and upstream pgBackRest license posture require dependency review before stronger environment or live-provider claims.
cliProviderBoundary.maintenancePosture: platform-data-dependency-owner reviews pgBackRest image and upstream release/advisory posture before version changes or stronger claims.
cliProviderBoundary.securityAdvisoryPosture: Dependency and container advisory review is required before stronger backup/restore, environment, live-provider, or production claims.
cliProviderBoundary.typescriptRuntimeCompatibility: The proof is TypeScript orchestration only and adds no runtime package dependency.
cliProviderBoundary.secretBoundary: The proof uses synthetic local credentials already authorised by the generated Postgres target and emits no raw password, endpoint, connection string, provider payload, table value, SDK error payload, token, or stack trace.
cliProviderBoundary.supplierBoundary: Local Compose pgBackRest proof is local evidence only; no live/provider-managed supplier readiness or subprocessor claim is made.

nonEquivalentSubstituteGate.substitutionNonEquivalenceBoundary: USF-211 proves pgBackRest local Compose cold backup/restore behaviour directly. DB/RLS, files, fixture, or documentation evidence remains non-equivalent to pgBackRest backup artifact creation, restore drill, RPO/RTO, PITR, DR, scheduled backup, or provider-managed operation.
